title: How to donate to the Red Cross after earthquake in Colombia via Grupo Aval ATMs
seoTitle: Donate to Red Cross via Grupo Aval ATMs after quake
subtitle: Grupo Aval opens over 2,700 ATMs and the dale! app to support earthquake victims
excerpt: On August 10, 2026, Grupo Aval opened over 2,700 ATMs and the dale! app so donations to the Colombian Red Cross could be directed to the response.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
On August 10, 2026, a magnitude 7.4 earthquake shook Colombia, causing damage in several municipalities. Grupo Aval responded by enabling donation channels through its banks, allowing the public to contribute directly to the Colombian Red Cross.

How to donate at Grupo Aval ATMs

Users can insert their card into any of the more than 2,700 ATMs of Banco de Bogotá, Banco de Ocidente, Banco Popular, and AV Villas, choose the “Donations” option, select the Red Cross campaign, and enter the desired amount. Upon confirmation, the donation is processed immediately.

Donation via the dale! digital wallet

Those who prefer using a phone should open the dale! app, access the Red Cross campaign, tap the campaign button, and confirm the transaction. The contribution is recorded instantly.

Destination of the raised funds

According to the statement, all money raised through the two channels will be allocated to the humanitarian response and assistance for the affected people.

Partnership with the “Colombia un solo corazón” initiative

In addition to its own tools, Grupo Aval joined the “Colombia un solo corazón” initiative, promoted by the national government, to mobilize resources for the care of people affected by the earthquake.

Operating period of the channels

The donation methods have been available since August 10 and will remain active throughout the emergency response phase.

With information from Semana.
